verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a way for partners to pre-fill applications, plus a CLI 'applications' command and applications:read/write scopes. However, no evidence shows that a founder can view or track the status of an account application while it is under review. The incorporation company-status endpoint tracks LLC/C-Corp formation, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, I can check my account application status while it's under review
